working_definition: P15 'tail' of differentiating neurons attached to the Tm9 cluster; the authors' call is 'probably immature Tm9 neurons'.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm9 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Immature form of the single named type Tm9. Confidence medium and verification flagged because of the authors' 'probably' hedge.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a transmedullary neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052333 immature transmedullary neuron Tm9 (exact), flagged for the authors' hedge.
